headline: UK Budget raises taxes on bank profits to fund energy bill relief
summary: The UK government announced a temporary surcharge hike on bank profits to help offset soaring energy bills and provide household relief in the new budget.
why: Bank profit surtaxes directly reduce net income for major UK lenders, affecting their dividend payout capacity and capital generation.

impacts.name: Banking Sector
impacts.why: Increased profit taxes directly lower net earnings for financial institutions operating in the UK.

why_moved: The introduction of a higher tax surcharge on bank profits diminishes projected earnings for UK financial institutions, triggering downward valuation pressures.
